summary: Tightened the remaining repo-side CI/bootstrap contract for the service browser gates. This iteration fixed two concrete gaps in the new validator slice: `scripts/validate-service-e2e-bootstrap.mjs` no longer treats `tests/e2e/service-details-visual.spec.ts` as part of the required CI service-browser contract when `service-quote-e2e` does not run that spec, and `.gitlab-ci.yml` now executes `node --test tests/scripts/validate-service-e2e-bootstrap.test.mjs` inside `service-quote-gates` so validator regressions are covered by pipeline automation. I also strengthened the validator earlier in this cycle so it fail-closes on the real preview startup contract: CI preview mode needs both `build/` and `.svelte-kit/output/server/manifest.js`, plus the explicit `SERVICE_E2E_BOOTSTRAP_MODE="route-harness"` and `VITE_E2E_TURNSTILE_BYPASS="true"` declarations. Focused verification is green for `node --test tests/scripts/validate-service-e2e-bootstrap.test.mjs` and `git diff --check`. The validator now correctly fails in this workspace for the remaining real blocker: `build/index.html` exists, but `.svelte-kit/output/server/manifest.js` is still missing locally, so CI-shaped `vite preview` / Playwright reruns cannot start yet even though `.gitlab-ci.yml` already preserves both `build/` and `.svelte-kit/output/` artifacts.
remaining_work: Ensure the upstream build artifact used by `service-quote-e2e` actually contains `.svelte-kit/output/server/manifest.js` alongside `build/`, then rerun the service Playwright job in the CI-shaped environment.
